name: Dataview
description: Shows the results of Dataview queries (TABLE, LIST and TASK) written in dataview code blocks, computed from the notes of the open folder.

status.noFolder: Open a folder to run Dataview queries.

task.changed: The task changed since the query ran. The results were refreshed.
task.conflict: {file} changed on disk. The results were refreshed; try again.

errors.expectedQueryType: A query starts with TABLE, LIST or TASK.
errors.unsupportedQueryType: {type} queries are not supported. Use TABLE, LIST or TASK.
errors.unsupportedCommand: {command} is not supported. Use WHERE, SORT and LIMIT.
errors.unexpectedEnd: The query ends too early; expected {expected}.
errors.expectedExpression: Expected a value or a field, found “{found}”.
errors.missingExpression: A value or a field is missing here.
errors.expectedField: Expected a field name after the dot.
errors.trailingInput: Unexpected “{found}” after the end of the expression.
errors.expectedSource: Expected a source (a tag, a quoted folder or a link), found “{found}”.
errors.fromNotFirst: FROM may appear once, right after the query type.
errors.invalidArgument: {name}() does not accept a value of type {type}.
errors.budgetExceeded: The query takes too long to evaluate. Narrow it down with FROM or WHERE.
errors.queryTooLong: The query is longer than {max} characters.
